activity_summary: At the Keys, before eleven, you and Richard left for the hill, and Kemp and Augustine came too. Augustine already has the pointing and is not handing it about. You are back for Errors at two. You are not going to the first Caesar.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left with Richard for the hill, and named the play you are coming back for.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Heard the guns and led you out.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Came to see a prince and refused to stay on the settle.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Came for the trumpet, with the pointing already in his sleeve.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Down from the Keys

entities.name: 1 Caesar
entities.context: Mentioned in Down from the Keys

facets.activity: Left the Keys for the hill

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The hill is where we stand

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: I have your pointing in my sleeve from Thursday;
